items.title: Send these readings to your care team this week
items.text: Your blood sugar readings were higher than the target, with an average of 235.2 mg/dL. Contact your care team this week to discuss your readings.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after meals may go with a smaller rise in blood sugar, especially after dinner. Try walking for 10 to 19 minutes after dinner to see how it affects you.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner late, like you do 100.0% of the time, may go with higher blood sugar. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You typically fast for 9.8 hours overnight, which is less than some other people. You might consider extending your overnight fast, but talk to your care team first.
